recommendation: Report competition at the level that awards contracts
evidence: Navy drove ~70% of the government-wide decline; its rate fell 45.8% to 36.6% on $176.6B.

recommendation: Test the 'we buy harder things' defence before accepting it
evidence: Portfolio adjustment explains only 6.1 pp of DoD's gap; 23.5 pp is practice, not mission.

recommendation: Use the September surge as a sampling frame, not a finding
evidence: September carried 19.0% of FY2025 obligations against an 8.3% even pace.

recommendation: Track contract-type risk as an independent signal
evidence: HHS cost-risk share rose 10.3 pp while its obligations fell 28.7%.

recommendation: Use the efficiency index only at its tails, never as a ranking
evidence: Only 4 of 19 agencies hold their quartile across 2,000 random weightings.

recommendation: Treat vendor concentration as a data-quality priority first
evidence: Vendor HHI is truncated at the top 100 and has no corporate-family rollup.
